abstract: Hyperglycemia drives rolling calcium oscillations in the beta cells of the islet, which results in secretion of insulin to achieve normoglycemia. Recent work by Deng et al. examines how the beta cells' neighbors, the alpha and delta cells, determine the frequency of calcium oscillation under glucose stimulation.
